notes: Wraps glMapBufferARB(target, access) (OpenGL.Companion.glMapBufferARB). Returns false immediately if already mapped (`c != 0`) or if the native call returns a null (0L) pointer. On success, calls the inherited protected setAddressAndSize-style method `a(address, size)` (see NativeBuffer.kt's `protected fun a(arg0: Long, arg1: Int)`) to record the mapped pointer/size, stores `target` in `c` (used later to unmap and as the is-mapped flag), and returns true. Param order inferred from glMapBufferARB(arg0, arg2) call matching (target, access) and arg1 being passed straight through to the address/size setter as the size.
Returns `c != 0`. Simple query for whether the GL buffer is currently mapped into client memory.

If currently mapped (`c != 0`): calls glUnmapBufferARB(target) (OpenGL.Companion), resets the inherited address/size to (0L, 0) via the protected setter, clears `c` to 0, and returns the driver's unmap result. If not currently mapped, returns true (no-op success) by virtue of the `local1 = true` default -- i.e. unmapping an already-unmapped buffer is treated as trivially successful.
